claims.claim: By the end of the hour: see your day, open a visit, work through the Visit Wizard (Steps 1 to 17, plus Step 2b) with wound measurements and photos, and sign the note.
Your admin has given you access to at least one facility and a role.
Have at least one visit scheduled for today; if not, ask your scheduler or admin to book one on the Fleet Calendar.
Patient Management opens My Clinical Day: your schedule for the day, patients who need scheduling, and overdue visits.
On the Fleet Calendar, the All Providers filter narrows to your column; each card shows the patient, time and status.
The Wound Cockpit opens from the patient's chart.
Switch the Fleet Calendar to week view at the start of the week to see what is coming.
Open a visit: Fleet Calendar appointment → Start Visit, or Wound Cockpit visit picker → Open.
The wizard opens with saved work loaded and all sections collapsed; open a section from the list; completed sections show a checkmark.
Work saves automatically as you go; the web app is online-only with no separate offline mode.

checks.pattern: debounce so every typed change persists within ~1s, with a 30s heartbeat

claims.claim: Sections with missing fields show what is missing and let you continue; nothing stops documentation.

The step headings are: 1 Consent & Attestation, 2 Patient Context & Demographics, 2b Clinical History Review, 3 Review of Systems (ROS), 4 Objective Assessment, 5 Functional Status & ADLs, 6 Comorbidities & Risk Factors, 7 Wound Assessment, 8 Previous Treatments, 9 Interventions & Treatments, 10 Care Planning, 11 Orders & DME, 12 Patient Education, 13 Procedure Supplies, 14 Current Medication, 15 Billing & Documentation, 16 LCD Audit & Review, 17 Provider Attestation.
Step 1 shows the consent on file; Capture consent, Record signed paper, Record verbal consent; a missing consent does not stop you.

checks.pattern: prompt is advisory: the visit can always be documented and signed.

claims.claim: Step 2: Chief Complaint (dictate with Voice); visit type comes from the appointment; insurance shown for reference only.

checks.pattern: To change insurance, use the patient's Billing & Auth page.

claims.claim: Step 2b: allergies, surgical, family and social history, current medications, problems and immunizations.
Step 3: body-system checklist filled from the prior visit; voice intake is available.

checks.pattern: // Voice intake completed for ROS section

claims.claim: Step 4: vitals BP, HR, Temp, SpO2, Respirations, Weight, Height, BMI; record the ABI here.
Step 5: ambulation and ADL independence. Step 6: diabetes, PAD, CVI, CHF, smoking status.
Step 7: etiology and stage, Treating/Monitoring, L/W/D cm, tissue percentages, exudate, pain, infection; photo recommended and does not block.
Step 8: prior offloading, compression, debridement and grafts, and the Medical Necessity Statement.
Step 9: debridement type, dressings, ultrasonic therapy; Generate Procedure Note.
Step 10: treatment goals, Follow-up Interval, Next Visit Date; Generate Draft gives an AI draft to accept, edit or discard.
Step 11: clinical orders and DME; DME fulfilled by a vendor; no product picker.
Step 12: handouts, Education Topics Covered Today, Patient Understanding Assessment.
Step 13: Box UID/UIN, lot and quantity, and any units wasted.
Step 14: medications and DoseSpot prescribing.
Step 15: Pull Codes fills billing codes from documentation (rule-based, no AI); check E/M level, modifiers, place of service.

checks.pattern: // ─── Pull Codes (deterministic mapper, no brain call)

claims.claim: Step 16: coverage-policy findings, a patient-level card and a row per wound, linking back to the section.
Step 17: typed electronic signature with name, credentials and NPI; tick the box and Complete Provider Attestation.
LCD badge re-checks about a second after each change; green/amber/grey; never red; never blocks Sign & Lock; click to run on demand.
Not ready to sign: leave the wizard; the visit stays an unsigned draft; reopen the same appointment to continue.
Continue to Review, check the note preview, Sign & Lock; a date mismatch prompt; inventory deducted at Continue to Review.

checks.pattern: 📋 [CONTINUE TO REVIEW] Updating inventory batch statuses...

claims.claim: After signing, the note is locked and filed, a claim is drafted for billing review, a Go to Billing prompt appears, and later changes need an addendum.

checks.pattern: toast.warning("Signed and locked — note still filing", {
status: 'pending', // Pending status - ready for biller review

claims.claim: Fleet Calendar: signed visits show Visit Completed; Progress Note In Progress means not yet signed.
Mileage & Expenses is not switched on yet: its page is marked Coming Soon!.
Result: start each day from Patient Management and the Fleet Calendar; wounds in the Wound Cockpit; chat in Team Chat.
